import type { FreeCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";

const MOVEMENT_MULTIPLIER = 20;

export function attachBigWorldFly(

  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  scene: SceneContext,

  let disposed = false;

    disposed = true;
    disposeControls();
    camera.speed = originalSpeed;
  };
}

}
